coupling_convention: C_G/f_a in GeV^-1 (ALP-gluon coupling), plotted exactly as on the y-axis; NOT converted to d_n in e*cm
notes: Beam EDM (cold neutron Ramsey) search for ALP-gluon coupling that induces an oscillating neutron EDM. Primary result reported as the axion-gluon coupling CG/fa (Fig. 4 y-axis, GeV^-1), best limit CG/(fa*ma) = 2.7e13 GeV^-2 (95% C.L.) in the mass range 2e-17 to 2e-14 eV; overall mass coverage 1e-19 to 4e-12 eV (23 uHz to 1 kHz). I emitted CG/fa values (GeV^-1) computed from the flat CG/(fa*ma) region, NOT d_n in e*cm — coupling type set to AxionEDM per the physical process (oscillating neutron EDM) but the emitted numbers are the gluon coupling CG/fa. Example given in paper: at ma=1e-15 eV, Ba=10 pT -> dn=8.6e-24 e cm -> CG/fa=1.4e-11 GeV^-1. DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed; both deterministic and stochastic limits shown.
